clue.text: Obsessive type teaches at Hogwarts?

parts.note: to teach someone is to train them, third person trains
Harry Potter is the boy wizard who studies at Hogwarts school in the J K Rowling books

explanation.surface: A wizarding-school master is described as someone obsessive.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'at Hogwarts' stands for its most famous pupil rather than describing where the teaching happens.
explanation.definitionFit: A rail enthusiast who logs locomotive numbers is the stock British example of an obsessive hobbyist.

clue.text: Finally allot deceased person's assets, being this

definitions.text: Finally allot deceased person's assets, being this

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word allot

parts.note: the property left by someone who dies is their estate

explanation.surface: An executor distributes a dead person's property, as the will directs.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a whole, the clue describes the condition of someone whose assets can be allotted under a will.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who dies having made a valid will is described in law as dying in that condition.

clue.text: Top copy with illiterate signature

parts.note: to ape someone is to copy or mimic them
a person who cannot write signs with a cross, X

explanation.surface: A head copy of a document bears a cross for a signature.
explanation.definitionFit: The peak or highest point of something is its top, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Tenor breaks into note heard neither sharp nor flat

indicators.note: breaks into shows the tenor letter pushing inside the other pieces

parts.note: aural means relating to hearing
T is the standard abbreviation for tenor in music

explanation.surface: A tenor's voice cuts into a note that is sung exactly in tune.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a note that is neither raised by a sharp nor lowered by a flat is called this.

clue.text: Kitchen plant for cooking endless pea broth

indicators.note: cooking suggests the ingredients being worked into a new form
endless says the final letter of the word pea is dropped

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A kitchen herb is wanted to flavour a pot of pea soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims PEA to PE; 'for cooking' then rearranges PE and BROTH into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot herb is any leafy plant grown to be cooked or used for flavouring in the kitchen.

clue.text: End time at university

definitions.meaning: a ... is a limit or conclusion, as in bringing something to ...
a university year is divided into teaching periods called ...

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a finishing point and one of the periods into which an academic year is divided.

clue.text: Broken toenail brings great joy!

indicators.note: broken suggests the letters of toenail are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: Someone is oddly delighted by breaking a toenail.
explanation.definitionFit: Elation is a feeling of great happiness or exhilaration, a direct synonym.

clue.text: What politicians on the stump do could give newspapers source of temptation

definitions.text: What politicians on the stump do

parts.note: newspapers collectively are the press
the flesh is one of the traditional sources of temptation, with the world and the devil

explanation.surface: Campaigning politicians might hand newspapers a juicy temptation.
explanation.definitionFit: Campaigning politicians shake hands with crowds, which is the idiom of greeting voters in person.

clue.text: Here, T May's core work

indicators.note: work as an anagram signal means the letters are worked into a new shape

parts.note: the apostrophe-s supplies an S to the fodder here

explanation.surface: This describes the heart of Theresa May's job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work' signals the anagram; Theresa May held this cabinet post before becoming Prime Minister, so the whole clue also describes her.
explanation.definitionFit: Theresa May served as the UK cabinet minister responsible for policing and immigration from 2010 to 2016.

clue.text: What gangster demands, muscle in among others

indicators.note: in among places the muscle inside the word for others

parts.note: the rest means the others
pec is short for pectoral, a chest muscle

explanation.surface: A gangster muscles in on rivals and demands deference.
explanation.definitionFit: Film gangsters famously demand to be shown due deference and esteem by everyone around them.

clue.text: Strong wind damaged a celebration

parts.note: something damaged may be torn
a do is an informal word for a party

explanation.surface: A gale wrecked a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent whirling windstorm, a kind of strong wind.

clue.text: Being crazy turned to use knife

indicators.note: turned says the word for crazy is read backwards

parts.note: bats is slang for crazy

explanation.surface: A madman resorts to a knife.
explanation.definitionFit: To stab is to strike or pierce with a knife or other pointed blade.

clue.text: Vintage traveller through space in small vessel

parts.note: a cru is a vineyard or its wine, a grade of vintage
ET is the extraterrestrial of the Spielberg film

explanation.surface: An old space traveller sits in a tiny ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A cruet is a small container for oil, vinegar or condiments at the table.

clue.text: Subtle punishment

definitions.meaning: ... means delicate or subtle, as in a ... distinction

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both delicate in distinction and a monetary penalty.

clue.text: Drive model car in wild place

indicators.note: in places the car inside the wild place

parts.note: a moor is open uncultivated upland
the Ford Model T was the famous early car

explanation.surface: Taking a model car out to drive on open moorland.
explanation.definitionFit: To motor is to travel by car, so it is a verb meaning drive.

clue.text: Subject: best one, first in class

parts.note: top means the best, as in top marks
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: first in picks the opening letter of the word class

explanation.surface: A school report: subject, best, top of the class.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is the subject of a discussion or piece of writing.

clue.text: Developing loftier plant like clover

indicators.note: developing suggests the letters of loftier evolve into another form

explanation.surface: A growing plant shooting up higher, clover-like.
explanation.definitionFit: Trefoil is a plant with three-part leaves, of the pea family, resembling or including clover.

clue.text: Sweet biscuit to have covered in cheese

indicators.note: covered in shows one piece wrapped within the other

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese
to own something is to have it

explanation.surface: A sweet biscuit topped with melted cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: A brownie is a small square chocolate cake, close enough to a sweet biscuit for a crossword.

clue.text: Peer given honour, one may bear a ring

parts.note: an earl is a nobleman, a peer
the OBE, Officer of the Order of the British Empire, is a British honour

explanation.surface: A lord receives an award.
explanation.definitionFit: The soft lower part of the outer ear is commonly pierced to carry an earring.

clue.text: Person in charge rounding up street criminal

indicators.note: rounding up shows the ruler going round the street

parts.note: a ruler is a person in charge

explanation.surface: A boss rounds up a street criminal.
explanation.definitionFit: A rustler is a thief who steals cattle or horses, so a kind of criminal.

clue.text: Go abroad rejecting Government for Arab country

indicators.note: rejecting says the letter for government is thrown out

parts.note: to emigrate is to go abroad to live

explanation.surface: Someone leaves the country, spurning the government, for an Arab land.
explanation.definitionFit: An emirate is a state ruled by an emir, such as those of the UAE in Arabia.

clue.text: Jolly one seen at work in takeaway

definitions.text: one seen at work in takeaway
definitions.meaning: a machine or worker in a fish-and-chip shop cutting potatoes into chips

explanation.definitionFit: The word means cheerful, and also a potato-cutting device found in a British fish-and-chip shop.

clue.text: Blade snubbed girl

parts.note: to cut someone is to snub them deliberately
lass is a Scottish and northern word for a girl

explanation.surface: A sharp-tongued girl was given the cold shoulder.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutlass is a short curved sword, a type of blade used by sailors and pirates.

clue.text: Person shunning extravagance cooks a turnip

indicators.note: cooks suggests the letters of a turnip are prepared in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A frugal person makes do by cooking a turnip.
explanation.definitionFit: A puritan is someone with strict morals who rejects luxury and pleasure.

clue.text: Be inclined to pay attention to poet

definitions.meaning: a ship that ... leans or tilts to one side
in poetry, ... is an old word for listen

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to tilt over, and is also archaic verse for listening carefully.

clue.text: Motorway a messy place with poor visibility

parts.note: the M1 motorway, written MI in crosswords, is Britain's main north-south motorway
a sty is a pigsty, any filthy untidy place

explanation.surface: A motorway is a messy place in fog.
explanation.definitionFit: Misty weather is foggy or hazy, giving poor visibility.

clue.text: Intelligence about Republican leads to legal document

indicators.note: about shows the intelligence word going round the Republican letter

parts.note: wit means intelligence or quick understanding

explanation.surface: A clever Republican produces a legal document.
explanation.definitionFit: A writ is a formal written court order, a type of legal document.

clue.text: Beat a Tibetan monk

parts.note: to lam is to beat or thrash

explanation.surface: Someone thrashes a Tibetan monk.
explanation.definitionFit: A lama is a Buddhist teacher or monk of Tibet.

clue.text: Accomplished politician, not Conservative

indicators.note: not says the Conservative letter is left out

parts.note: Vince Cable was a leading Liberal Democrat politician

explanation.surface: A skilled politician who is no Tory.
explanation.definitionFit: Able means skilled or competent, a synonym of accomplished.

clue.text: Free from insult an Asian potentate's wife

indicators.note: free from signals letters released from within the phrase that follows

explanation.surface: An Asian ruler's consort is spared an insult.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultana is the wife of a sultan, a Muslim sovereign or potentate.

clue.text: Judge toasted rarebit

indicators.note: toasted suggests the letters of rarebit are cooked into a different form

explanation.surface: A judge eats Welsh rarebit, cheese on toast.
explanation.definitionFit: An arbiter is someone who decides a dispute, a judge or referee.

clue.text: Engineer in attendance behind Brunel's ship

indicators.note: in places the engineer letters inside the attendance word

parts.note: the gate is the number of people attending a sports match
RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army engineering corps
astern means at or towards the back of a ship

explanation.surface: An engineer attends behind Brunel's vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Engineer' looks like Brunel himself; it gives RE. Isambard Kingdom Brunel was the Victorian engineer who built this huge iron steamship.
explanation.definitionFit: The SS Great Eastern was the giant iron steamship designed by Isambard Kingdom Brunel, launched 1858.
